notes: Sign-in and reconnect no longer fight the relay's flood guard. The relay bans any address that connects too often inside two minutes, and FleetComm's own retry loops — six nets and the control link each retrying on their own clock — could cross that line during an outage and then keep the ban re-armed forever: the 'rate-limiting' screen some of you saw, where trying again never worked. Every connection now passes through one shared budget that stays under the guard, and when a ban is detected FleetComm holds ALL reconnects long enough for it to actually lift, counts the hold down on screen, then relinks on its own. A relay that is simply DOWN or restarting now says so instead of being called rate-limiting. Also in this build: a dead network path (PC slept, Wi-Fi roamed, router rebooted) is noticed within 20 seconds instead of leaving you on a silent net that still looks tuned for ten minutes; switching microphones in SYS works instead of failing with 'couldn't open that microphone'; the CONNECT button can't be double-fired while a connection attempt is in flight; and the updater no longer leaves a Windows scheduled task behind that could re-run an old update at 23:59.
